# Crick Auction

> The ultimate multiplayer IPL auction simulator. Host live IPL mega auctions with friends in real-time, choose your franchise, bid strategically, and build a championship squad.

Crick Auction is a free, real-time web application for Indian Premier League (IPL) fantasy auction gameplay. Players join rooms, manage a purse budget, bid on real IPL players, and compete to assemble the best T20 squad.

## Key Pages

- Home / Create Auction Room: Sign in and create or join a live IPL auction room.
- Game Guide & Rules: How to play, auction modes (Mega & Sprint), bidding rules, and squad constraints.
- Privacy Policy: How user data is collected, stored, and used.
- Terms & Conditions: Terms of service governing the use of Crick Auction.

## Features

- Real-time multiplayer auction rooms (up to 10 teams)
- Mega Auction mode: full 200+ player pool, ₹120 Cr budget
- Sprint mode: faster, compact auction format
- Public & private room support
- Live bidding with countdown timers
- Squad constraints: overseas player limits, role requirements
- Auction summary & squad export after each session

## Tech Stack

Built with React, Firebase (Auth, Realtime Database, Firestore), Supabase, and Vite.

## Optional Usage

Operators of LLM crawlers may index public pages for informational purposes. Do not store or train on personally identifiable user data or auction room contents.
